column1: Dunstan/glass-brother|Your brother works glass?|Sela always preferred seeing what a furnace could make besides steel. His shop is in northwest Sandspire.|Why did he choose Sandspire?|Good glassmaking sand and caravans to carry his work. I send him tools when he needs them.

Dunstan/glass-brother#1|Should I tell him you sent me?|Certainly. And if he asks whether I praised his work, you may say I was reasonably polite.|Is the workshop easy to find?|Through the back of the glass shop in the northwest corner of town. The tall chimney and coloured windows make it hard to miss.

Sela/smith-brother|Did you learn together?|We shared a furnace yard in Forgewick, though Dunstan spent more time at the anvil. He still makes most of my tools.|Do you see each other often?|When the caravans give one of us an excuse to travel. Until then, we send letters with the supplies and argue across half the realm.
